# Design Tokens (generated)

**Do not edit anything in this directory by hand.** Every file here is generated by
`tools/build_tokens.py` from the YAML frontmatter of the design docs. Edit the frontmatter
in the relevant `DESIGN.md`, then regenerate:

```bash
python3 tools/build_tokens.py            # rewrite this directory
python3 tools/build_tokens.py --check    # fail if it is stale (use in CI)
```

## Files

| System | Source | JSON | CSS |
|--------|--------|------|-----|
| sqrDAO | `DESIGN.md` | `sqrdao.json` | `sqrdao.css` |
| YouAI | `youai/DESIGN.md` | `youai.json` | `youai.css` |
| Web3 Builders' Summit | `summit/DESIGN.md` | `summit.json` | `summit.css` |
| Da Nang Blockchain Hub | `danang-hub/DESIGN.md` | `danang-hub.json` | `danang-hub.css` |
| EMpower Founders Residency | `empower-residency/DESIGN.md` | `empower-residency.json` | `empower-residency.css` |

`index.json` lists every system with the doc version its tokens were built from.

## Using them

Import the CSS and read the custom properties, rather than pasting hexes into a stylesheet:

```css
@import "tokens/sqrdao.css";

.cta {
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: var(--color-accent-text);
  border-radius: var(--component-button-radius);
}
```

sqrDAO ships a light mode as a `[data-theme="light"]` block in the same file, so setting
`data-theme="light"` on a container re-points the same variables. Remember that gold is
fill-only in light mode: use `var(--color-accent-text)` for gold *text*.

For JS/TS consumers, import the JSON directly.

## Conventions

CSS custom properties are namespaced by the frontmatter section they come from:

| Frontmatter | Prefix | Example |
|-------------|--------|---------|
| `colors` / `colors-light` | `--color-` | `--color-accent` |
| `secondary-accent` | `--secondary-accent-` | `--secondary-accent-main` |
| `spacing` | `--spacing-` | `--spacing-md` |
| `breakpoints` | `--breakpoint-` | `--breakpoint-md` |
| `typography` | `--font-` | `--font-label-letter-spacing` |
| `components` | `--component-` | `--component-card-radius` |

Sections not listed (`brand`, `formats`) are metadata and appear only in the JSON.

Two things the generator does deliberately:

- **Prose fields are dropped from CSS.** Keys named `note`, `description`, or `comment`
  document a token for a human; they are kept in the JSON and never emitted as a property.
- **Unresolved placeholders ship commented out.** A value like `"<pixel-display>"` means the
  brand has not settled that token. Emitting it live would hand consumers a silently broken
  font stack, so the line is commented out and the build prints a warning. Resolve it in the
  DESIGN.md frontmatter to make it real.
